Position description

The University of California, Merced, Department of Economics and Business Management invites applications for one full-time tenure-track faculty appointments at the Assistant Professor level,
beginning July 1, 2027.

Preferred candidates will have expertise in applied work in any subfield and will be able to contribute broadly to teaching in Economics and Business programs. A Ph.D. degree in Economics is expected at the time of appointment.

 The University of California, Merced, is the newest of the University of California system’s 10 campuses.
